raw:
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.status NOT IN ('A', 'C') THEN l.loan_id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) 
FROM main.loan l 
WHERE l.date BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31'
